A configuration draft was kept in this b.zh: 此浏览器标签页中保留了一份配置草稿。可恢复草稿，或改用仓库中的版本。

Approval rule name is required..zh: 审批规则名称不能为空。

Browse files on the selected branch..en: Browse files on the selected branch.
Browse files on the selected branch..zh: 浏览所选分支中的文件。

Browse organization projects and clone U.en: Browse organization projects and clone URLs.
Browse organization projects and clone U.zh: 浏览组织项目并查看克隆地址。

CI variable key is required..zh: CI 变量名称不能为空。

Can claim jobs; verify this host is isol.en: Can claim jobs; verify this host is isolated for CI workloads.
Can claim jobs; verify this host is isol.zh: 可以领取任务；请确认此主机已隔离，仅用于 CI 工作负载。

Cancel all pending and running jobs in t.en: Cancel all pending and running jobs in this pipeline?
Cancel all pending and running jobs in t.zh: 确定取消此流水线中所有待处理和正在运行的任务吗？

Cancel this job and stop its current exe.en: Cancel this job and stop its current execution?
Cancel this job and stop its current exe.zh: 确定取消此任务并停止当前执行吗？

Canvas edits update YAML. Commit to appl.en: Canvas edits update YAML. Commit to apply changes.
Canvas edits update YAML. Commit to appl.zh: 画布中的修改会同步到 YAML。提交后才会生效。

Check the pipeline tab for queued or rec.en: Check the pipeline tab for queued or recent pipeline runs.
Check the pipeline tab for queued or rec.zh: 请前往流水线标签页查看排队中或最近的运行记录。

Choose a pending item from your work lis.en: Choose a pending item from your work list.
Choose a pending item from your work lis.zh: 请从待办列表中选择一项。

Choose how Gity looks. Changes apply and.en: Choose how Gity looks. Changes apply and save in this browser immediately.
Choose how Gity looks. Changes apply and.zh: 自定义 Gity 的外观。更改会立即应用并保存在此浏览器中。

Commit .gity-ci.yml to your repository,.en: Commit .gity-ci.yml to your repository, then run a pipeline.
Commit .gity-ci.yml to your repository,.zh: 先将 .gity-ci.yml 提交到仓库，再运行流水线。

Configuration pinned to this run.zh: 此配置已固定到本次运行

Create a CI config file in the source br.en: Create a CI config file in the source branch to trigger pipeline generation.
Create a CI config file in the source br.zh: 在源分支中创建 CI 配置文件以触发流水线生成。

Create a project in this organization to.en: Create a project in this organization to start pushing code.
Create a project in this organization to.zh: 在此组织中创建项目，即可开始推送代码。

Create file requires repository write ac.en: Create file requires repository write access
Create file requires repository write ac.zh: 创建文件需要仓库写入权限。
